cues: Swap the hydrogens for two bulky ethyl groups.
They crowd each other and push apart, opening the angle to one hundred and eleven point seven degrees.
The molecule is still bent, so the two carbon oxygen dipoles do not cancel.
Ether is polar, with a dipole moment of one point one five debye.
